concept.hr: Zapisivač piše u i-čvor: create traži reload, a copytruncate može izgubiti retke
concept.en: The logger writes to an inode: create needs a reload, copytruncate loses lines

summary.hr: Rotiraj /var/log/messages tjedan po tjedan dok zapisivač piše: brojevi i datumi, compress, create s reloadom ili bez njega i copytruncate.
summary.en: Rotate /var/log/messages week by week while the logger writes: numbers and dates, compress, create with or without a reload, and copytruncate.
